name: repository-harness
description: Harness validation manifest. Every check add-on follows the same uniform shape: { description, enabled, severity, messages, parameters }. metadata entries carry description + data and are not validated. The harness is not versioned. Unknown top-level keys are logged as WARN by the validator main routine (no add-on entry for that — it is the default behavior).

requireFilesExist.description: Every path in parameters.paths MUST exist as a regular file under the target repository root.

requireDirectoriesExist.description: Every path in parameters.paths MUST exist as a directory under the target repository root.

requireKeepfileInEmptyDirectories.description: Each directory in parameters.directories MUST contain at least one real file or a .gitkeep placeholder.

messages.default: empty directory must keep placeholder or real files: {directory}

requireTemplateGroups.description: Each group in parameters.groups MUST exist as a directory under parameters.targetRoot.

requireDocHeadings.description: Each authored .md file derived from parameters.sourceFilesFromCategory.paths and matching parameters.sourceFilter MUST contain every heading in parameters.headings.

requireDocContent.description: For each entry in parameters.checks, the concatenation of files content (newline-joined) MUST contain every substring in containsAll. Otherwise the entry's failureMessage is emitted.

checks.failureMessage: root contract (CLAUDE.md, aliased as AGENTS.md) must contain Repository Harness Contract
root contract must contain an Entry Point section
root contract must reference AGENTS.md so both filenames resolve to the same document
root contract must describe docs/generated/ semantics
repository docs must describe generated-artifact source command and regeneration trigger metadata
root contract must state that the harness may evolve across development phases

requireAgentFrontmatter.description: Every .md file directly under parameters.directory MUST start with parameters.frontmatterStart and contain every field in parameters.requiredFields. The `name` value MUST match parameters.namePattern.

messages.missingDirectory: .claude/agents must contain at least one .md agent

requireSkillFrontmatter.description: Every file named parameters.filename under parameters.rootDirectory (any depth) MUST start with parameters.frontmatterStart and contain every field in parameters.requiredFields.

messages.missingDirectory: .claude/skills must contain at least one SKILL.md

forbidScaffoldLeaks.description: Scan every file under parameters.scope.bases (excluding excludedSubtrees and files whose extension is not in extensions) and emit a finding for every regex match in parameters.patterns.

requireHookShebang.description: Each hook in parameters.hooks MUST start with the line in parameters.expectedShebang.

requireHookExecutable.description: Each hook in parameters.hooks MUST have its executable bit set on disk.

requireHookGeneratedMarker.description: Each hook in parameters.hooks MUST contain parameters.markerTemplate (with {name} substituted) and MUST NOT contain parameters.placeholderForbidden.

parameters.placeholderForbidden: packaged placeholder is replaced during harness installation

requireHookStage.description: Each hook MUST contain parameters.markerTemplate with {stage} substituted from parameters.stages[<stack>][<hookName>]. The active stack identifier is supplied by the validator at runtime.

messages.default: {hook} must contain stage marker '# Harness stage: {expectedStage}'

requireHookCommand.description: parameters.prePushHook MUST declare and run a command listed in parameters.allowedCommands[<stack>]. When parameters.allowedPreCommitCommands[<stack>] is non-empty, parameters.preCommitHook MUST also declare and run one of those commands; otherwise pre-commit MUST NOT run any full-stack validation command.

messages.commandNotRun: {hook} must run the declared validation command
messages.preCommitMustNotRunFullStack: pre-commit hook must not run full stack validation commands

requireCiCommandMatchesHook.description: Each existing file in parameters.ciFiles MUST contain the validation command declared by parameters.referenceHook. Absent files are skipped.

requireEnvShebangUnder.description: Any executable script under parameters.directories whose first line starts with `#!` MUST start with parameters.expectedPrefix.

forbidUncheckedTasksUnder.description: Every file matching parameters.filenamePattern under parameters.directory MUST NOT contain any line matching parameters.uncheckedTaskPattern. Enforces that plans moved into directory have all tasks marked done.

forbidUnsafeSymlinks.description: All scanned files and directories MUST NOT be symbolic links, except symlinks within parameters.allowedSymlinkPairs (root contract symlinks).

messages.scanRootNotAllowed: symlink scan root is not allowed: {path}
messages.scanEntryNotAllowed: symlink scan entry is not allowed: {path}

forbidImplicitLambdaIt.description: Kotlin lambdas under parameters.directories MUST declare an explicit parameter name; the implicit `it` is forbidden.

messages.default: Kotlin file {file} uses implicit `it` lambda parameter at line {line}; use an explicit name

requireSingleTopLevelKotlinDeclaration.description: Each Kotlin source file under parameters.directories MUST declare exactly one top-level declaration, and that declaration MUST be one of parameters.allowedDeclarations. Catches accidental top-level val/var/fun declarations.

messages.default: Kotlin file {file} has multiple top-level declarations or a disallowed declaration kind

seedFiles.description: Optional placeholder files the harness installs but the target repository MAY replace, rename, or remove. Not a check.

generatedArtifacts.description: Policy for docs/generated/. Not a check.
generatedArtifacts.policy: Place actual generated repository artifacts here. Do not add fake placeholder files; keep the directory empty with .gitkeep until a real generation step exists.

harnessEvolution.description: Policy for how the harness evolves. Not a check. The harness is not versioned — the current committed state is the only authoritative shape.
harnessEvolution.policy: The in-repository harness may evolve across discovery, implementation, hardening, release, and maintenance. The current committed harness is the active contract; no schemaVersion, no deprecated keys, no compatibility shims.

teamPatterns.description: Catalog of team/agent collaboration patterns this harness recognises. Not a check.
